case_number: 2025 INSC 271; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 21965 OF 2022)
summary: Tenant eviction for landlord's bona fide need; ultrasound business establishment for unemployed sons; validity of prior compromise decree for partial eviction; expertise requirement for medical equipment irrelevant; tenant's other accommodations non-bar to eviction; need assessed as of suit filing date; appellate courts erred in denying bona fides; suit decree restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments set aside; eviction suit decree upheld; tenant ordered to vacate premises.
